Package filters

Class InternshipFilter

java.lang.Object
filters.InternshipFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
FilterCriteria<Internship>
public class InternshipFilter extends Object implements FilterCriteria<Internship>
Implements FilterCriteria for Internship objects. This class holds a wide range of criteria (e.g., status, major, level, dates) and checks if a given Internship object matches them.
Version:
1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • InternshipFilter

      public InternshipFilter()
      Empty constructor. Creates a filter with no criteria set.

    • InternshipFilter

      public InternshipFilter(InternshipStatus status, String preferredMajor, InternshipLevel level, LocalDate latestClosingDate, LocalDate earliestClosingDate, LocalDate latestOpeningDate, Boolean studentVisibility, String companyName, String companyRepId)
      Constructs a new InternshipFilter with specified criteria. Null values for any parameter will cause that criterion to be ignored.
      Parameters:
      status - The InternshipStatus to filter by.
      preferredMajor - The preferred major to filter by.
      level - The InternshipLevel to filter by.
      latestClosingDate - Filter for internships closing on or before this date.
      earliestClosingDate - Filter for internships closing on or after this date.
      latestOpeningDate - Filter for internships opening on or before this date.
      studentVisibility - Filter for visibility status (true/false).
      companyName - Filter for an exact company name match.
      companyRepId - Filter for an exact company rep ID match.
